command.manageMarks.title: Edit Mark Assignments
command.refresh.title: Recalculate Marks
config.folderBadges.description: Show aggregated marks on folders (a folder carries the highest-priority mark found inside it).
config.marks.description: Mark assignments: a list of catalog items with a chosen glyph. Items without an entry do nothing. Edited from the 'GlyphMark: Edit Mark Assignments' form. The list order is the priority order: when several items match a file, the earliest entry’s glyph is shown (every match stays visible in the tooltip).
config.paletteStyle.description: Glyph palette shown first in the assignment form: monochrome symbols drawn in the editor's UI font, or colour emoji. This only switches the picker palette — marks already assigned do not change.
config.title: GlyphMark-Solo
extension.description: Your own glyphs on the files and folders you hunt for. Assign a mark to a catalog item (created recently, updated frequently, last edited by me, path contains...) and matching Explorer entries carry it - your icon theme stays untouched.
